item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russian forces continue drone and missile strikes on Ukrainian civilian sites, while Ukrainian forces retaliate with strikes on Russian airports, a Tolyatti factory and a Krasnodar Krai airfield. In occupied Oleshky, a local cease-fire negotiated by Melania Trump has reduced fighting, and a separate truce was agreed for another town. Starlink speed restrictions have been lifted, restoring stable connectivity for Ukraine's military. A secretive Ukrainian deep-strike unit is expanding its campaign, and Ukrainian forces have reportedly struck targets up to 2,500 kilometres from the border. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

The Hebron raids have displaced thousands of Palestinians and detained dozens, while the United Nations has cut food aid, increasing hunger among displaced residents. In Yemen, Houthi attacks on Aden and Sanaa have caused civilian casualties, and Saudi airstrikes in Houthi-controlled areas have also killed civilians, including women and children. item.title: Somalia: the situation
item.description:
Fitgharan forces now control the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, expanding fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia has withdrawn more than 3,000 troops and will not intervene in the South West State conflict, and a UAE drone strike in Puntland killed four family members, including a pregnant teenager. The US and UAE also carried out airstrikes against al-Shabaab in northern Somalia. 2,284 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Armed groups also targeted electricity workers in Benue, prompting a service withdrawal, and killed a woman and injured two farmers in Plateau. Bandits killed seven vigilantes and abducted thirty-eight people in Zamfara. The conflict produced 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Eastern DR Congo: the situation
item.description:
Ebola has reached an eighth province in eastern DRC, prompting alerts in Lubumbashi and border closures by Kenya and Uganda after 12 truck drivers were killed. The ADF continues attacks in Ituri while the FRN operates near Lubumbashi, and both UPDF and FARDC are conducting joint operations against ADF commanders in the region. A mercenary force suffered combat casualties in the Congo, and rebel-linked violence has led to civilian deaths. The conflict produced 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
